versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Changelings wear the text and tribe of shop units, keeping their own small bodies, and leave a cheap Stock token behind.
Payoffs grow units for wearing often and across many tribes, with ladders for copying your own board, sold units and enemies.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Pinned down the unclear rules: what counts as a wear (Stocks, Tod's sales; not fight guises), that wearing a Changeling skips its guises, and that Start of Combat guises fire at once.
Pip now mirrors only left and right, the Steward's guises stack, Tod may choose to wear, and every Changeling can wear up to your tier minus 2 so early wearers last.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
A Stock no longer wears on its own: it wears its remembered unit only when the Alder Whittler or Wicker Moll says so, so the Whittler has a job.
Bee Orchid now buffs every Changeling that has a guise, and a new Guise rule says copied texts each trigger while golden text doesn't stack.
